== Description ==

[[Randy Scott]] (left foreground, orange Denver Broncos cap, blue DENVER BRONCOS tee, glasses, beard, black zip, grey shorts, playing), [[Anthony Howard]] (mid-right, blue Los Angeles Dodgers cap, black tee, goatee, playing), [[Ziemowit Skwara]] (right foreground, short blond-brown hair, glasses, headphones around the neck, black zip hoodie, playing (red sleeves)), and [[Jordan Gosiaco]] (far right, WILSON hoodie, curly hair, glasses) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025.
